detail.description: AnkiMCP 是一个 Anki 插件，它实现了 MCP 服务器，使 AI 助手能够与 Anki 抽认卡应用程序进行交互。在版本 0.21.0 之前，“anki_mcp_server/mcp_server.py”通过“TransportSecuritySettings”和“enable_dns_rebinding_protection=False”全局禁用 FastMCP DNS 重新绑定保护，包括默认的本地 Streamable HTTP 侦听器。 “anki_mcp_server/config.py”中的默认值在“127.0.0.1:3141”上启用“http_enabled”，并使用空的“http_path”选择根端点。在“initialize”、“tools/list”和“tools/call”到达 MCP 调度之前，不会强制执行不记名令牌、API 密钥、会话密钥、严格的“Host”白名单或严格的“Origin”白名单。在 Anki 和侦听器运行时访问恶意网页的受害者可以将浏览器请求反弹到环回，从而允许攻击者“初始化”MCP、枚举工具、读取本地集合以及执行启用的非破坏性音符/牌组创建或更新。攻击者既不需要 LAN 位置，也不需要本地进程。可用的操作取决于启用的工具过滤器；除非选择“enabled_delta_tools”，否则破坏性工具将被隐藏，从而限制删除级别的影响，但不限制公开的读/写操作。报告的工具证实了真实的 MCP 工具调度与替代的 Anki 桥接响应，而不是展示对真实集合的破坏性变化。禁用隧道/代理保护也会禁用正常环回配置。此问题已在 0.21.0 版本中修复。
detail.kind_en: 依赖反向 DNS 解析来执行安全关键操作
detail.title: CVE-2026-61546 漏洞

detail_original.description: AnkiMCP is an Anki addon that implements an MCP server, enabling AI assistants to interact with the Anki flashcard application. Prior to version 0.21.0, `anki_mcp_server/mcp_server.py` globally disables FastMCP DNS-rebinding protection through `TransportSecuritySettings` with `enable_dns_rebinding_protection=False`, including for the default local Streamable HTTP listener. The defaults in `anki_mcp_server/config.py` enable `http_enabled` on `127.0.0.1:3141`, with an empty `http_path` selecting the root endpoint. No bearer token, API key, session secret, strict `Host` allowlist or strict `Origin` allowlist is enforced before `initialize`, `tools/list` and `tools/call` reach MCP dispatch. A victim who visits a malicious web page while Anki and the listener are running can have browser requests rebound to loopback, allowing the attacker to `initialize` MCP, enumerate tools, read the local collection, and perform enabled non-destructive note/deck creation or updates. The attacker needs neither LAN position nor a local process. Available operations depend on enabled tool filters; destructive tools are hidden unless `enabled_destructive_tools` is opted into, limiting deletion-level impact but not the exposed read/write operations. The reported harness confirms real MCP tool dispatch with substituted Anki bridge responses rather than demonstrating destructive changes to a real collection. Disabling protection for tunnels/proxies also disables it for the normal loopback configuration. This issue is fixed in version 0.21.0.
detail_original.kind_en: Reliance on Reverse DNS Resolution for a Security-Critical Action
